source: Measured run of the '*HotPath*' filter (--iterationCount 3 --warmupCount 1, the CI settings)
provenance: Regenerated against benchmarks that exist. The previous file (version 1.0, 2026-01-25) named 20 benchmarks that appear in no source file in this repository, so every comparison missed, the gate REFUSED on every run, and no performance claim was ever actually checked. Keys here are BenchmarkDotNet Benchmark.Method values, the field eng/ci/perf-regression-check.ps1 matches on.
measurementCaveat: These means were measured on a developer workstation, not on a CI runner, and CI compares runs from ubuntu-latest, windows-latest and macos-latest against this one file. Absolute means are therefore machine-dependent and a cross-machine delta is not necessarily a code regression. Re-record from a CI run when one is available. allocatedBytes, unlike meanNs, is machine-independent and is recorded here for that future use; the gate does not compare it today.

notCompared.why: Recorded, deliberately not compared. These are NOT deleted: the gate iterates only "baselines", so entries here are preserved for provenance without producing verdicts the measurement cannot support.
